tools.name: scan_text_for_ai_leaks
tools.description: Statelessly inspect prompt text, support transcripts, or tool JSON for API keys, bearer tokens, private keys, emails, phone numbers, IPs, SSNs, credit cards, and custom sensitive terms, returning masked text and finding counts.

tools.name: estimate_ai_workload_cost
tools.description: Calculate estimated monthly AI inference cost and local/budget/premium routing mix based on workload volume, routing preference (budget, balanced, deadline), and project template.

tools.name: compare_llm_pricing
tools.description: List current model input/output pricing per 1M tokens and context windows from Spendplane's routing catalog, with optional substring filter.

tools.name: simulate_reversible_agent_redaction
tools.description: Demonstrate Spendplane's opt-in Reversible Agent Privacy Add-On: masks entities into run-scoped placeholders ([EMAIL_01], [CUSTOMER_ID_02]), checks per-tool/field allowlists, and verifies cross-run token blocking.

tools.name: get_spendplane_architecture_guide
tools.description: Return verified setup instructions, endpoints, pricing tiers, and architectural documentation for Spendplane Gateway, AI Safe Desktop/Mobile, Reversible Agent Privacy, and Customer Portal.

tools.name: draft_code_with_free_model
tools.description: Delegate code, configuration, or boilerplate drafting to Spendplane's zero-cost free-model pool with pre-egress PII/secret redaction so premium agent tokens are only spent on review and verification.
